title: kith-chat: process_update enqueue_receipt after readAt
description:
In process_update, after update_read_at succeeds, enqueue a Peer/receipt if the message is inbound.

**What:** Wire enqueue_receipt into the Message/set readAt update path.

**Algorithm:**
1. In crates/kith-chat/src/message.rs, fn process_update:
   a. Rename _now_unix parameter to now_unix (remove leading underscore — it is now used).
   b. After the successful guard.messages().update_read_at(server_id, read_at_unix) call:
      i.  Look up the message: guard.messages().get(server_id). If None or Err, log and skip receipt (do not fail the update).
      ii. Check if msg.sender_id != "self". If sender_id == "self" (outgoing message), skip receipt silently.
      iii. Look up contact: guard.contacts().get_by_peer_user_id(&msg.sender_id). If None or Err or contact.blocked, skip receipt silently — do not fail the update.
      iv. Call: let _ = guard.outbox().enqueue_receipt(server_id, &msg.sender_id, &contact.mailbox_host, read_at_unix, now_unix);
         (Use let _ = to silently ignore enqueue errors — a failed receipt enqueue must not fail the readAt update.)
   c. drop(guard) then return Ok(()) as before.

2. All callers of process_update must pass now_unix (check process_update call sites — typically called from MessageSetHandler::call with a now_unix parameter already available).

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Receipt enqueue failure must NOT fail the readAt update (use let _ =).
- Only enqueue for inbound messages (sender_id != "self"). Never send a receipt for your own outgoing messages.
- Only enqueue if contact is found AND not blocked. If blocked, skip silently.
- No logging of message body or any PII in this path.

**Agent team:** R (read message.rs process_update + call sites) + I.

**Tests:** cargo test -p kith-chat must pass clean. The existing test_read_receipt_incoming_message and test_read_receipt_outgoing_message tests in kith-chat serve as oracles — verify both still pass.
